<!--
Base branch: develop (GitHub preselects main; change it).

Title: a one-line Conventional Commit, for example `fix(chd): extract CD images to one bin per track`.
It becomes the squash commit subject (for a single-commit PR, that commit's subject is used), and for feat, fix, and perf the changelog line.
Use the same style for your commit subjects. See CONTRIBUTING.md.

Body: what changed and why, in a few sentences. Add `Closes #N` if this fixes an issue.
Visual changes: before and after screenshots. No checklists.
-->
